Overnight Policy Rate (OPR)

Source: R/opr.R
get_opr.Rd

This function allows you to obtain data on Overnight Policy Rate (OPR) decided by the Monetary Policy Committee from the BNM API.

Usage

get_opr(year = NULL)

Source

https://apikijangportal.bnm.gov.my/

Arguments

year

Optional. Integer value above 2000. Series of integer values also supported (experimental).

Details

This function has initial support for vectorisation, i.e. returning a single tibble given a vector of years as arguments.

Examples

if (FALSE) get_opr() # \dontrun{}
get_opr(2018:2019)
#> # A tibble: 12 × 4
#>     year date       change_in_opr new_opr_level
#>    <int> <chr>              <dbl>         <dbl>
#>  1  2018 2018-01-25          0.25          3.25
#>  2  2018 2018-03-07          0             3.25
#>  3  2018 2018-05-10          0             3.25
#>  4  2018 2018-07-11          0             3.25
#>  5  2018 2018-09-05          0             3.25
#>  6  2018 2018-11-08          0             3.25
#>  7  2019 2019-05-07         -0.25          3   
#>  8  2019 2019-07-09          0             3   
#>  9  2019 2019-09-12          0             3   
#> 10  2019 2019-11-05          0             3   
#> 11  2019 2019-01-24          0             3.25
#> 12  2019 2019-03-05          0             3.25
